title: The Missing Child
description: Elin didn't come home two nights running and half the hamlet's convinced hooded men dragged her into the woods. I've heard her talk about lights past the tree line for a month and I never asked who was showing them to her. Find the ruin in the forest. Find out if anyone made her go.

objectives.description: Search the cultist ruins in the forest for Elin

notes: Threat: a girl missing two nights, the hamlet assuming abduction. Giver motive: the elder's own guilt at never asking about the lights she mentioned, and no militia to send. Consequence of refusal: unwired. Invented: the girl's name, Elin - no bible basis, local colour.
